text:
Under FIFA’s updated regulations aimed at preserving match integrity and deterring dissent, referees are now explicitly empowered to issue Red Cards to players who leave the pitch in protest of a decision.
The rule also extends accountability beyond players to include team officials who incite such actions.
This was done in the wake of a controversial final at the X tournament held in Rabat in January 2025—where Y players staged a dramatic on-field protest by walking off for over 15 minutes after a late penalty decision favoring Z.
